description: Defines classes and structures for managing frame timestamp events, histories, and deltas in Android's graphics pipeline, including FrameEvents, FrameEventHistory, ProducerFrameEventHistory, ConsumerFrameEventHistory, FrameEventsDelta, and FrameEventHistoryDelta.

classes.name: FrameEvents
classes.description: Represents timestamps and fence information for a single frame.

classes.name: FrameEventHistory
classes.description: Manages a collection of FrameEvents, tracking frame history.

classes.name: ProducerFrameEventHistory
classes.description: Producer-side interface for managing frame event history and fences.

classes.name: NewFrameEventsEntry
classes.description: Represents a new frame event record created by the consumer.

classes.name: FrameEventDirtyFields
classes.description: Tracks which frame event fields have been modified or sent.

classes.name: ConsumerFrameEventHistory
classes.description: Consumer-side interface for managing frame event history and deltas.

classes.name: FrameEventsDelta
classes.description: Represents a single frame update delta from consumer to producer.

classes.name: FrameEventHistoryDelta
classes.description: Collection of frame event updates (deltas) to be sent between consumer and producer.

methods.name: isValidTimestamp
methods.description: Checks if a timestamp is valid (not pending).

methods.name: getFrame
methods.description: Retrieves a FrameEvents object by frame number.

methods.name: checkFencesForCompletion
methods.description: Checks fences associated with frame events for completion.

methods.name: dump
methods.description: Outputs the state of FrameEvents or FrameEventHistory to a string.

methods.name: updateAcquireFence
methods.description: Updates the acquire fence for a specific frame.

methods.name: applyDelta
methods.description: Applies a delta of frame events to the history.

methods.name: addQueue
methods.description: Adds a new frame event entry to the consumer history.

methods.name: addLatch
methods.description: Records latch time for a frame.

methods.name: addPreComposition
methods.description: Records pre-composition refresh start time.

methods.name: addPostComposition
methods.description: Records post-composition timing and fences.

methods.name: addRelease
methods.description: Records release fence and time for a frame.

methods.name: getAndResetDelta
methods.description: Retrieves and resets the delta of frame events.

methods.name: resize
methods.description: Resizes the internal frame history buffer.

methods.name: operator=
methods.description: Assignment operator for FrameEventHistoryDelta.

methods.name: getFlattenedSize
methods.description: Calculates size needed to flatten the object.

methods.name: flatten
methods.description: Serializes the object into a buffer.

methods.name: unflatten
methods.description: Deserializes the object from a buffer.

methods.name: getFrameNumber
methods.description: Returns the frame number associated with the delta.

methods.name: getLatchTime
methods.description: Retrieves latch time from a frame delta.

methods.name: getDisplayPresentFence
methods.description: Retrieves display present fence from a frame delta.
